page.overview:
Who is Katy?

Katy is a character appearing in Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet. She is the Gym Leader at Cortondo's Gym and is one of the eight Gym Leaders in which the player can fight in any order they chose. She specializes in types.

Katy is a slightly plump woman with teal hair and brown eyes. She has a fair-skinned appearance. Befitting her secondary job as a pastry chef, she wears a chef uniform consisting of a light-gray blouse with a matching hat and gloves, a brown ascot, a matching long brown skirt and a waist apron of the same color of her skirt. She also has a spider web on her apron and wears brown tights and white shoes.

Her -type preference is reflected in the many antennas in her clothing and also her waist band giving the impression that she has a segmented body much like a real bug.

Katy is compassionate and kind-hearted. She enjoys the nature of -types and loves to cook. Despite her friendly personality, Katy takes Gym battles seriously, although due to her Gym being frequented by aspiring Trainers, she usually doesn't get the chance to go all out. This changes when after the rematch, Katy realizes that going easy on early trainers is not doing them any favors and decides that she is going to give them a stronger taste of reality, implying that while she is outwardly sweet and kind, her motherly personality inside wishes to instill some discipline in young trainers who are looking to better themselves, putting in the same level of effort she does for her pastry shop and doing things "the old-fashioned way".
